reason: I already have a LARQ I'm happy with and it comes on my commute every day. I don't need a second filtered bottle, especially from a brand I'd never heard of until this video.
objection: Never heard of Claro, so it could just be a rebranded cheap bottle with a creator code on it, and I'd be paying $68 up front plus signing up for a filter subscription to find out.
would_change_my_mind: My LARQ breaking or getting lost, plus independent lab test results on the filter and real reviews from people who aren't paid to post about it.
